## Selected Research

### The Health Returns to School Air Conditioning: Evidence from Summer Ambulance Use in Japan

*Revised and resubmitted at the European Journal of Health Economics.*

This paper studies whether classroom air conditioning improves child health, 
using school-origin ambulance use in Japan and quasi-experimental variation 
in public-school air-conditioning installation.


### Electricity Prices, Temperature, and Ambulance Use: Evidence from a Tariff Hike in Japan

This paper studies how increases in regulated electricity tariffs affect 
home-origin ambulance use and how the health response varies with outdoor temperature.
